raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner uncritically accepted a misleading search snippet that attributed 60–85 million deaths to World War I (figures that belong to World War II), misidentifying the war with over 60 million casualties. This led to concluding “World War I” despite later evidence that the memorial commemorates both wars and only World War II fits the >60 million criterion.
